findings.explanation: Haruki begins to say that their meeting is not a coincidence, prompting Setsuna to answer that it is only half a coincidence because she predicted his arrival time. The English makes him affirm that it is a coincidence, contradicting her immediate qualification and reversing his recognition that she partly waited for him.

findings.highlight: "If only I'd studied hard and acquired a recommendation like you did… My parents have been really bugging me about how I can't retake my entrance exams. All our savings got eaten up by my sister, after all."
findings.evidenceJa:
「やっぱお前みたいに頑張って推薦取っとけば…
ウチ一浪までって親に釘刺されてるんだよなぁ。
貯金は全部姉ちゃんが食い潰しちゃってるし」
findings.explanation: Takahiro says his parents permit no more than one additional year as a ronin applicant; the English says he cannot retake the entrance exams at all.
